# MekkoChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMekkoChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasMekkoChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasMekkoChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasMekkoChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

100% stacked columns of *different widths* (Marimekko / mosaic)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasMekkoChart](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMekkoChart.md)
- [UltraCanvasEngineCharts](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMekkoChartElement> CreateMekkoChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMekkoChartElement> CreateMekkoChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<MekkoChartDataVector> data, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMekkoChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### struct `MekkoChartSeries`

A series is one horizontal band of the chart (one legend entry).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `color` | `Color color` |  |

### struct `MekkoChartColumn`

A column is one variable-width vertical bar; it holds one value per series.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `values` | `std::vector<double> values` | Aligned with the series list; missing = 0 |
| `category` | `std::string category` | Optional grouping/annotation |

Methods: `GetTotal`

### enum `MekkoMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Marimekko` | 100% stacked: column height normalized, Y axis in percent |
| `BarMekko` | Absolute stacked: column height = column total, Y axis in values |

### enum `ColumnSortMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DataOrder` | Keep insertion order |
| `TotalDescending` | Largest column first |
| `TotalAscending` | Smallest column first |
| `Alphabetical` | Sort by column label |

### enum `SegmentLabelMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLabels` | No text inside segments |
| `Value` | Absolute value |
| `Percent` | Percent of column |
| `ValueAndPercent` | "value (percent)" |
| `SeriesName` | Series name (useful when legend is hidden) |
| `SeriesAndValue` | "series: value" |

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
